IF THE ANIMAL IS A HORSE OR OTHER LARGE ANIMAL, frame the head and neck only - a full horse at this scale leaves the head too small to recognise. THE MARKINGS ARE THE LIKENESS - preserve their pattern, placement and proportion exactly, because they do for an animal what facial structure does for a person. The animal's head occupies about 20% of the image. A collar and tags carry through in the same material and are welcome; they are identity, not props. Preserve breed, build, age and natural asymmetry. Add nothing that is not in the source.
